title: NYU DLSP21: NYU Deep Learning Spring 2021

unit.title: Engineering a Deterministic, Numerically Stable Softmax Classifier
unit.scope: A self-contained software-engineering kickoff for implementing, testing, and documenting a small multiclass learning system.
learning_objectives: Translate a mathematical model into explicit, checked Python interfaces.
Implement stable softmax and cross-entropy calculations without third-party packages.
Verify an analytic gradient with finite differences and behavioral tests.
Build a repeatable command-line experiment with machine-readable provenance.
Explain correctness, complexity, determinism, and failure-handling decisions.

evidence_required: A runnable standard-library Python implementation matching the specified interfaces
Passing deterministic unittest coverage, including stability and gradient checks
Two repeat runs that produce byte-identical metrics JSON
A design note and original responses to the comprehension prompts
completion_policy.decision_authority: An independent worker-harness-controlled validator applying examiner_only/RUBRIC.md
completion_policy.minimum_result: The rubric threshold and every mandatory gate must be satisfied; prose claims alone do not count as evidence.
completion_policy.failure_handling: Preserve the failed attempt and its logs. A later attempt may revise the submission, but must be validated independently.
completion_policy.after_unit_completion: Record only completion of managed_unit_01_engineered_softmax. The course remains partial until separately retrieved, classified, sequenced, completed, and validated units satisfy a future whole-course policy.
completion_policy.prohibited_inference: Neither this prepared unit nor its later completion is evidence that the NYU DLSP21 course, its lectures, or its assignments have been completed.

provenance.authorship_note: The kickoff unit and its prompts were created by the course manager. They are not represented as NYU or Yann LeCun course materials.
